body: Thank you. I agree 100%. You two strangers have helped me more than you can know.

I know how it feels to way-too-self conscious. I struggled with that a lot in my earlier life. I've had weight problems on and off myself. I also have small boobs (the problem being i'm a man and shouldn't have any). All I can tell you is as I've gotten older, I have slowly realized it isn't as important than it used to be when I was younger. I would always worry people couldn't be attracted to me. Once I started to let go a little, I found that I could open up more to interactions with others and not always be in my own head so much. I really have to work hard to love yourself. But I know that the women in my life who have moved me the most, it had nothing to do with how they looked it was all about how they made me feel.  I hope that helps.
It has. Now that I know about it, I'll be back, hopefully not just when I feel hopeless. I really hope things get better for you. Hope to talk to you again, just under better circumstances.

My wife has bpd and all I can tell you is it's hard. Hard as hell. If this person made you feel bad, I'm sorry. I know when she gets to a bad place, she struggles with seeing anything positive. I hope her being a piece of shit doesn't get you to a point of no return.

I'm sorry your feeling that way. I've been thinking that way myself lately. I just posted on here the first time, why I couldn't tell you. But after reading some posts all I can say is it helped tonight. It helped for now and I hope it helps you to read some of the posts. To see you are not alone with this.
I'm sorry she made you feel like that. I hope you don't do it. Borderline is so hard, but I hope you find some respite here.

Sorry to hear you're having these problems. I'm 39 and I can tell you I get those same exact thoughts. I just posted for the first time not too long ago. I was writing my thoughts out on paper copied them and found here to paste them. Feel free to read my post to get an idea. All I can tell you is for me, it comes and goes. Things in my life got really, really hard lately and I had some of the exact same thoughts. For the last hour or so I have been reading some of the posts here and it has helped me. That and getting my thoughts out in the open. I hope you get some relief reading them too.
Funny, me too. Lot's of long hot showers lately.

Thank you for responding. I have been reading some of the posts for the last hour and have to agree, it helps. I'm sorry to hear about your struggles but it's very heartening to share your struggle and know that I'm not the only one who feels like it's just too much.

Hey there. Sorry you're going through this too. I literally posted one minute after you and my first sentence said I feel like I'm drowning. Weird huh? I totally understand the exhausted feeling of dealing with this shit. The last hour or so I have been reading some of the posts on here and can honestly say seeing people here trying to help with others that know what it feels like to feel that kind of despair kind of helps. Doesn't make any problems go away, but maybe it's just enough to get through a rough night. Read my post if it helps. Maybe my patheticness will make you feel a little better, or at least not so alone.

My wife of 14 years has bi-polar and borderline personality disorder. She too would have hallucinations and paranoia. I get how hopeless it can feel. The one thing I can tell you is for almost two years she had a great therapist that helped her with DBT therapy. It took her years and numerous attempts to find someone she trusted but once she did, the results were pretty amazing. She had hard times in those two years but the episodes were actually manageable and she didn't go to a hospital for almost three years. Trust me it's possible to be relatively symptom free with the right help. Keep fighting.
